messages:
marie: heads-up — need to finalize PRD + canary plan for the tenant-weighting rollout next quarter. two customer-driven asks (Acme HIPAA flow) and one PLG feature. can we align on scope tradeoffs, acceptance criteria, and rollback triggers by EOD Fri? draft here: https://redwood.internal/prd/tenant-weighting-draft :paperclip:

aj: quick q — are we planning per-tenant version pinning or just org-level pins? per-tenant pins add complexity to routing and billing.

lia: from PM ops POV the priority matrix favors Acme (revenue + contract) but HIPAA bumps scope (private deploy or VPC). PLG feature can be deferred to next cycle.

sandeep: SRE point — we need automated rollback + circuit-breaker. propose:
```
if error_rate_5m > 2% OR p95_latency_10m > 2000ms then trigger rollback
if continuous_errors_3m > threshold then disable canary and alert oncall
```
also require health-check endpoints and traffic shadowing enabled during ramp.

oren: ML gating — model quality checks need to run on canary cohort. recommend: hallucination_rate delta > 1.5% vs baseline OR BLEU/ROUGE drop > X triggers pause. start with 2% of traffic for 24h, then 10% for 24h, then 30% for 24h. daily manual review during canary.

marie: draft acceptance criteria I'm proposing:
- canary ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 72h with automated stop on thresholds above
- per-tenant pinning supported at rollout, default TTL 48h unless extended by support
- rollback automation wired to SRE playbook, runbook link included
- privacy mode toggle for Acme (VPC/private) validated in staging
- docs + customer comms ready before canary
Is that actionable or too ambitious? :thinking_face:

aj: actionable. I'll own the runtime flags + rollout scripts (eng-runtime). planning to add a "pin-ttl" flag and per-tenant routing table.

lia: I'll draft the customer comms and highlight the 48h pin TTL. looping legal on HIPAA checklist now.

sandeep: I'll add the alert rules to ops-config and the automatic rollback lambda. also need a metric owner for model-quality signals — @oren?

oren: I can be metric owner for model QA. will provide eval harness + baseline numbers by Thu.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-job v1.3 -> staging at 2025-07-15T09:00:00Z (owner: aj) :rocket:

marie: perfect — I will consolidate these into the PRD and ping reviewers. open questions to answer in the PRD: pin granularity (tenant vs org), pin TTL exceptions for enterprise customers, who owns metric alerts, and whether we need an emergency rollback knob in the console. @aj @sandeep please confirm by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
